description: This Java class 'ChargeRepositoryWrapper' provides a wrapper around 'ChargeRepository' to include additional logic for detecting and handling not found or inactive 'Charge' entities during data retrieval.

classes.name: ChargeRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class providing a safe retrieval method for 'Charge' entities, throwing specific exceptions if entities are not found or inactive.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a 'Charge' by ID, throwing exceptions if the charge is not found, marked as deleted, or inactive.
